extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset
extraction.description: A dataset of 246,285 texture images across 56 texture classes generated using a text-to-image model with a three-stage refinement process.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated using a text-to-image model, Stable Diffusion, with a three-stage refinement process consisting of frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection consists of texture-specific prompts used as inputs to the Stable Diffusion model.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset underwent a three-stage refinement process: (1) frequency filtering to remove object-like images, (2) patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images, and (3) CLIP score filtering to ensure alignment with prompts.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human evaluations were conducted to assess the quality and representativeness of the images in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The human evaluation results showed a 3.4% increase in quality and a 4.5% increase in representativeness after applying the refinement process.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset can be used to measure texture bias in machine learning models and has potential applications in texture-based research and analysis.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases towards certain texture classes or prompts, but the refinement process aims to mitigate these biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to 56 texture classes and may not cover all possible texture variations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training, testing, and validation of machine learning models, particularly in texture-based research and analysis.
